text_block_list.text:
Hearing some lively voices,
I head over to the fields to take a look—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, look over there—an amaryllis!
And gladioluses, and dahlias, too!
And to top it all off, a hibiscus!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, it's really red and flashy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Passionate, scorching, enthusiastic!!
It is utterly perfect for the theme of "Summer Flower Bed", desu!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can tell you've put a lot of thought into this in your own way.
Though making it a reality might be a bit difficult.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Special Week,
what's your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! When I think of summer flowers,
sunflowers are definitely the first to come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: There was a sunflower field near my home too, so I was really hoping we could see them under the academy's summer sky...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, sunflowers, huh? A solid, classic choice.
Though lacking novelty for a brand-new flowerbed
is a drawback—
choice_data_list: You're making a new flower bed?
Are you making a new flower bed?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove-san's Trainer!
Hello there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're going to plant some new summer flowers here.
We're just discussing our plans right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Originally, this was a matter entrusted to Grass Wonder of the Beautification Committee, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass has been flat on her back with a fever since yesterday, desu.
However, she has such a strong sense of responsibility that if there's something on her plate, she won't rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So we ripped it right off
and came up with an alternative idea instead, YES!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful mindset,
but both opinions have their pros and cons.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Just out of curiosity, tell me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A plain yet realistic plan" or "A flashy yet difficult plan"...
Which would you choose?
choice_data_list: A flashy plan, but difficult to pull off

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, going the safe route, are we, desu?
That's a very senior Trainer-like choice, desu!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, as expected of the reigning symbol
of summer flowers, there are many ways to showcase them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let us flesh out the details of the flower bed,
while ensuring it achieves a flashiness that satisfies you as well.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Could you add red for me too, desu ka!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Let's add some red, too.

And just as the meeting to hash out the details was winding down,
Air Groove suddenly spoke up during the break.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of sunflowers—
Do you know the fable associated with this flower?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I heard about that from my mama a long time ago!
Umm, if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A girl fell in love with the Sun God, and as she kept gazing at the sky chasing after the sun, her body eventually transformed into a flower, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: When I asked, "Why do sunflowers face the sun when they bloom?", they told me all about it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Quite knowledgeable, aren't you, Special Week?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, please hold on, DESU!
Did that girl just turn into a flower, DESU!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That sounds kinda scary... or rather,
a bit of a sad story, deee-su...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... there are many interpretations that view it
as a tragedy born of being driven mad by love.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, I came away with a different impression.
choice_data_list: What were your thoughts on it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The maiden continued to yearn for that which was impossibly far away.
Such passion and courage are worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And surely...
she became what she wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Into large, blooming flowers reminiscent of the summer sun,
as if mirroring the image of what one yearns for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I find both a maiden's strong will and a noble flower
to be truly beautiful."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Oooohhhhh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What the.
Hey, what is the matter with every single one of you?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-Wait... Air Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It was so romanticcc~...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
E-Everyone, forget what just happened!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's an order!! Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I threw out some ideas too, but
I think El-chan's idea is really great!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If we had a flower bed like that in the academy,
it feels like it'd cheer everyone up...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ho... So you stubbornly choose to challenge it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Now that's a true member of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
I shall take command and lead us flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A crimson performance that will captivate one and all—
I will overcome every obstacle to make it reality!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First, secure the essentials!
Men, follow me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh~... What incredible heat and intensity...!
She truly is the "Empress", desu...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Awawa... Did we accidentally light a fire under someone incredible...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it, I've heard about that, desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And Air Groove-senpai is the same in races—
it's when clashing against stronger rivals in tougher
situations that she truly smiles...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-What does this mean...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: She says it's far more fun when she meets opponents who are worth crushing... worth breaking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"People call that, you see――
'The Empress's Ferocious Smile'……!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeh~...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
M-Mommy...
Will I really be able to pull this off without a hitch...1?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A bright red flowerbed, huh... Heh, hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Interesting! My blood is boiling...!!

...She looked like she was having fun,
so I let it slide.
